Interim and blinded observations are preliminary, are not statistically powered to establish efficacy, and may not be predictive of topline or final results.

Following the protocol-defined six-week treatment period, final participant dosing is expected to conclude mid-November 2026, after which the Company expects to proceed with database lock, unblinding, and topline analysis.
The Company anticipates reporting topline results during the December 2026/January 2027 timeframe, subject to clinical trial and data management uncertainties.

The precise timing of key clinical milestones, such as the availability of topline data, is uncertain because it involves multiple statistical analyses, including by independent statisticians, and depends heavily on their schedules.
